free_tier.stated: No free tier and no free trial; a 30-day money-back guarantee is the only risk reversal.

per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: 6,642+ days of article retention, in the plan table

egress.terms: Unlimited Data, Unlimited Speed, Unlimited Bandwidth, Unmetered Access

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: An alternative front end to the Omicron spool for a client who wants the VPN bundled; it does not add a second feed to another Omicron subscription.
limits_note: Monthly $7.99; yearly $5.83/mo at a 55% discount with unlimited VPN included. The monthly plan sells the VPN separately at $4.99.
binding_note: Unlimited volume and speed, 50 connections, no published fair-use cap.

identity_cost.detail: Email, country and credit card are the fields on the signup form; there is no trial, so a card is required before the first byte.

reliability_note: Omicron spool served as sslusenet.com (us.sslusenet.com and nl.sslusenet.com) - the same hosts Fastusenet uses. No VPN bundling on the monthly tier.
confidence_note: Prices and limits read from the live signup page today, including the visible payment form.

evidence.proved: $7.99/mo monthly; $5.83/mo yearly at 55% off; 50 connections; 6,642+ days; payment form asks for credit card, cardholder name
Account Information block asks for Email Address and Country before payment
